_note: Real PS5 captures from the user: phone photos of a TV (perspective skew, glare, moire, right edge cropped). Ground truth read by Claude from the images. Only fields that are legible in the photo are listed.

status-photo-01.jpg._statsNote: Displayed stats sum to 186 => level 107, but Level reads 87. The +20 is exactly Radagon's Soreseal (+5 Vig/End/Str/Dex), so the Status screen shows stats INCLUDING talisman bonuses. Base stats are therefore vigor 59, mind 14, endurance 22, strength 16, dexterity 18, intelligence 9, faith 15, arcane 13 (sum 166 => level 87).

equipment-photo-01.jpg._gridNote: Other slots are icon-only (two axes, a shield-like offhand, armor set with red-plumed helm, four talismans, quick items). Identifying them needs icon matching against the item image index, not OCR.

_inventoryNote: Inventory pages print ONLY the highlighted item's name (list header + right panel). Every other cell is an icon (+ stack count for goods). Reading a full inventory from photos therefore needs per-cell icon matching restricted to the page's category, with OCR only for the header name, the tab title and stack counts. Counts are read left-to-right, top-to-bottom, skipping empty cells.

inventory-bolstering-01.jpg._countsNote: Row groups: 8 smithing-stone cells, then 5 Grave Glovewort cells (selected [1] first), then 5 darker glovewort cells, then 1 large glovewort. Exact stone/glovewort grades per cell must come from icon matching; only counts and the selected name are ground truth.

inventory-sorceries-01.jpg._note: Every sorcery cell carries the red X 'cannot use' badge (player Int 9 < requirements); the required Int number is drawn in red. The badge is a cheap cross-check against the character's stats.
